title: Oklahoma Income Tax Act
source_id: Okla. Stat. tit. 68, secs. 2351 et seq.
verified_how: queried the Legislature's own statute search (Title 68, SearchText 'Oklahoma Income Tax Act'): 12 current sections carry the short title, the lowest being 68-2351 (the short-title section), with 68-2353, 68-2355 and several versions of 68-2358 also returned. 'Title 68 - Revenue and Taxation' confirmed on the titles index, currency 'last updated on November 18th, 2025'.
notes: Covers the personal income tax and employer withholding. The search returned several sections with 'v1'/'v2'/'v3'/'v5' version suffixes on 68-2358, which indicates multiple concurrently published versions of that section on the register - a human should check which version is operative for a given tax year.
